string: Apex Measure Pro connects to your Leica DISTO laser measure over Bluetooth so measurements go straight into your window sheet. It is not used for anything else.
The microphone is used only when you tap the voice button, so you can speak measurements instead of typing them.
Speech recognition turns the measurements you speak into numbers on your sheet.
The camera is used to take photos of windows and rooms that you attach to a job.
Photo access lets you attach existing photos of windows and rooms to a job.
